title: Penthouse Magazine December 1986 Special Holiday Issue Vintage
conditionDescription: Small tear at the top of the spine. Complete, no missing pages noted.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, December 1986 - Special Holiday Issue. Cover features include an exclusive with Henry Kissinger, an investigative report on faith healers, Mike Tyson as the next heavyweight champion, and a report on religious fanaticism. Lucky Strike ad on the back cover.
Condition: Pre-owned. Small tear at the top of the spine (see photos); otherwise complete, no missing pages noted.
Adult magazine - buyer must be 18+.
